title: Replace latest-schema DDL with migration-first SQLite schema management
description:
Replace the current hand-maintained latest-schema DDL plus TypeScript migration-chain model with migration-first SQLite schema management.

Problem:
Eshyra currently has a latest-schema bootstrap block and a migration chain that both affect schema shape. That creates duplicate schema authority and allows bootstrap DDL such as CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS / CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS to mask incomplete migrations. Since Eshyra is still pre-1.0, this is the best time to move to a durable model.

Target design:
- Versioned SQL migration files are the only executable source of truth for schema changes.
- Empty DB creation applies all migrations from zero.
- Existing DB startup applies only pending migrations.
- A migration ledger records applied version, name, checksum, and timestamp.
- A generated schema snapshot may exist for review, but it is generated from migrations and verified, not hand-maintained authority.
- Legacy meta.schema_version databases are either adopted safely or rejected with a clear pre-1.0 reset message.

Acceptance criteria:
- Add a migration-first design note or ADR covering source of truth, migration ordering, checksum policy, legacy adoption/reset policy, and bootstrap-row handling.
- Add versioned SQL migrations under packages/core/src/persistence/migrations or an equivalent clear location.
- Encode the current intended schema as 0001_initial.sql.
- Add schema_migrations ledger with version, name, checksum, and applied_at.
- Empty DB initialization applies ordered migrations transactionally.
- Existing DB initialization verifies already-applied migration checksums and applies only pending migrations.
- Remove hand-maintained latest-schema CREATE TABLE/CREATE INDEX authority from initSchema.
- Add tests for fresh init, repeated init, pending migrations, checksum drift, and legacy adoption/reset behavior.
- Add a migrated-vs-fresh schema parity guard where meaningful.
- Document the authoring workflow for future schema changes.
close_reason: All 7 children merged to main (PRs #313-#318 across the migration-first series; runner/baseline/adoption/initSchema-rewrite/tests in #316-#318). Migration-first SQLite schema management complete per ADR 0015: versioned SQL migrations are the sole executable authority, schema_migrations ledger replaces meta.schema_version, latest-schema repair DDL and the legacy TS chain are removed, legacy DBs adopt-at-baseline-or-reset, and parity/idempotency/checksum/snapshot are test-guarded.
